say:3:1410539001:1.text: Huh? What magic is this? Why are the leaves curling up?
say:3:1410539001:1.source_cn: 咦？这是什么魔法？为什么叶子被卷起来了？

say:4:1410539002:0.text: Oh, that's just the wind—it's the power of nature, not magic.
say:4:1410539002:0.source_cn: 这是风，是自然的力量，不是魔法。

say:5:1410539003:1.text: I see... The surface doesn't seem dangerous at all! It feels so warm and safe here... completely different from what Her Majesty said.
say:5:1410539003:1.source_cn: 地表一点也不危险，这里又温暖又安定……和女王陛下的教导...

say:6:1410539004:0.text: So... maybe all those other records were wrong too?
say:6:1410539004:0.source_cn: 也就是说……其他的记载也可能是错的？

say:7:1410539005:1.text: As a true researcher, I need to experience everything on the surface for myself! I'll bring the truth back to share with everyone!
say:7:1410539005:1.source_cn: 不行，我得仔细感受地面的一切！我要把真相带回去告诉大家！

say:8:1410539006:0.text: Okay, go ahead and take it all in!

say:9:1410539007:1.text: Huh? What was that sound? I heard a loud echo, followed by shrill cries...
say:9:1410539007:1.source_cn: 唔？刚刚那是什么声音？我听到很大的回响，一阵又一阵，还...

say:10:1410539008:0.text: Well, we're near the ocean. Look up and see, those are sea birds.
say:10:1410539008:0.source_cn: 这里是海边，有很多海鸟。你抬头，看看飞在天上的那些家伙。

say:11:1410539009:1.text: They are so far away... Too bad I can't quite make out their shape...
say:11:1410539009:1.source_cn: 它们飞得太高了，我看不清它们的样子……好可惜……

say:12:1410539010:0.text: We can wait. They come down lower at dusk.
say:12:1410539010:0.source_cn: 等等吧。黄昏时它们会飞得低一些。

say:14:1410539012:0.text: ...Oh no, how do I explain this?

say:15:1410539013:1.text: Sorry, have I been asking too many questions?
say:15:1410539013:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我是不是问太多了？

say:16:1410539014:0.text: No, no, it's not that... I just don't have the answer right off the top of my head! But don't worry, I'll share what I do know!
say:16:1410539014:0.source_cn: 不不不，我只是不知道怎么解答而已！没关系，让我们从头说起……

say:19:1410539015:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look at that boy. He's so curious and innocent, just like a little one discovering the world for the first time.
say:19:1410539015:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look at that boy. He's so curious and innocent, just like a little one discovering the world for the first time.
say:19:1410539015:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look at that boy. He's so curious and innocent, just like a little one discovering the world for the first time.

say:20:1410539016:1.text: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.
say:20:1410539016:1.source_cn: 我们带他来到地上，这些一直生活在地底的艾塞勒，说不定也...
say:20:1410539016:1.male: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.
say:20:1410539016:1.female: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.

choice_prompt:21:1410539016.source_cn: 我们带他来到地上，这些一直生活在地底的艾塞勒，说不定也会像鸟一样飞到别处去。

choice_prompt:21:1410539016.female: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.

say:22:1410539017:0.text: Oh, yeah! I almost forgot about those two fluffballs!
say:22:1410539017:0.source_cn: 哎哟，忘记那俩小家伙了！
say:22:1410539017:0.male: Oh, yeah! I almost forgot about those two fluffballs!
say:22:1410539017:0.female: Oh, yeah! I almost forgot about those two fluffballs!

say:23:1410539018:0.text: Oh, young man, we left those little ones on the surface. Now look at us, finally tracking you down, and we haven't even had the chance to tell them yet!
say:23:1410539018:0.source_cn: 霍根老弟，之前我们分头行动，让他们留在地表找你。结果好...

say:24:1410539019:0.text: Young man...? You look much younger than me.

say:25:1410539020:0.text: Ahem... Anyway, now it's time for us to go find them!
say:25:1410539020:0.source_cn: 咳咳——！总之，现在该轮到咱们找那俩小仓鼠了。

say:26:1410539021:1.text: Right. No wonder it felt quieter than usual today. Anyway, old friend, I truly appreciate you coming to rescue me once again.
say:26:1410539021:1.source_cn: 我就说少了什么。老朋友，多亏你一片苦心……
say:26:1410539021:1.male: Right. No wonder it felt quieter than usual today. Anyway, old friend, I truly appreciate you coming to rescue me once again.
say:26:1410539021:1.female: Right. No wonder it felt quieter than usual today. Anyway, old friend, I truly appreciate you coming to rescue me once again.

say:27:1410539022:1.text: We should let them know we're safe so they stop worrying.
say:27:1410539022:1.source_cn: 现在确实应该叫他们回来了。报个平安，别让他们担心。
say:27:1410539022:1.male: We should let them know we're safe so they stop worrying.
say:27:1410539022:1.female: We should let them know we're safe so they stop worrying.

choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 得告诉漫漫和满满我们回来了
